name: TeamStarWolf - npm Supply-Chain Attacks, 2018 to 2026
description: Enterprise ATT&CK v20.0 techniques bound in the npm supply-chain case study. Score 100: an ATT&CK procedure, software mapping or technique description in ATT&CK v20.0 ties the technique to an npm worm, loader or group in the study's record. Score 50: the study's own mapping, labelled Inferred in its comment. Comments carry the study's source numbers. This is not an official MITRE mapping.

legendItems.label: 100: ATT&CK-published link to an npm object in the record
50: analyst inference, labelled in the comment

techniques.comment: ATT&CK procedures: S9008 Shai-Hulud, S9043 Mini Shai-Hulud, S9042 CanisterWorm, S9034 Tsundere Botnet, S1246 BeaverTail, G1056 TeamPCP and G0082 APT38 (malicious dependencies in the Axios and Mastra npm packages). Events: Shai-Hulud (2025-09-15), axios (2026-03-31), Mini Shai-Hulud (2026-04-29). Sources: [162]; [166]; [22]; [35]; [38].
ATT&CK description names NPM; sole procedure G1052 Contagious Interview. Event: Socket identified more than 338 malicious npm packages (report 2025-10-10). Sources: [163]; [24].
ATT&CK procedures: S9008, S9043, S9042, S9041. Every npm payload in the record is JavaScript run by Node or a browser. Sources: [160]; [161]; [166].

ATT&CK procedures: S9008 postinstall and preinstall hooks, G0082 post-install hooks in Axios and Mastra, G1056 preinstall scripts, S9041 install-script injection. Events: coa preinstall (2021-11-04), Shai-Hulud 2.0 preinstall (2025-11-24). Sources: [164]; [7]; [26].

ATT&CK procedures: S9008 (.github/workflows/discussion.yaml), S9043, S9042, G0082. Events: shai-hulud-workflow.yml (2025-09-15); Nx pull_request_target injection (2025-08-26). Sources: [160]; [166]; [22]; [18].
